Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :s_ctrl_group is not null then
 begin
 select code_desc into :s_group_desc from master_codes
 where code_type='ATTR' and code=:s_ctrl_group and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate)>=sysdate;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 message('Invalid Code');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others then null;
 end;
 end if;
 go_query('valid_attributes');
end;
